'''Alex D. Rogers''' is professor of [[conservation biology]] and fellow of [[Somerville College, Oxford|Somerville College]], [[University of Oxford]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.zoo.ox.ac.uk/people/view/rogers_ad.htm|title=Department of Zoology, University of Oxford|website=Zoo.ox.ac.uk|accessdate=12 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171110192951/http://www.zoo.ox.ac.uk/people/view/rogers_ad.htm|archive-date=10 November 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://oxfordoceanresearch.org/alex-david-rogers/|title=Prof. Alex David Rogers|date=12 February 2016|website=Oxfordoceanresearch.org|accessdate=12 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171111095359/https://oxfordoceanresearch.org/alex-david-rogers/|archive-date=11 November 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.voicesfromoxford.org/people/dr-alex-rogers/539|title=Dr Alex Rogers - Voices From Oxford|website=Voicesfromoxford.org|accessdate=12 November 2017}}</ref>
